title: NOPE! CP Moth Killer Spray - Fast acting, Odourless, Long-lasting Moth Repellent for Clothes, Home, Wardrobe, Room & Carpets. (5L)
bullet_points: Professional-quality pesticide spray, highly effective Clothes Moths killer. Can be applied on multiple surfaces such as carpets, soft furnishings or interior surfaces of cupboards, wardrobes, drawers, or other home storage.
Pet & child-safe poison-free formula - Our simple but effective sticky trap has a low environmental impact to efficiently removes UK Clothes Moths moths without toxins.
Fast-acting Contact Killer – Can be applied directly on flying moths with excellent knockdown effect or as a spot treatment.
Long-Lasting – Effective against all moth life cycle stages: eggs, larvae, pupa/cocoon, and adult. Delivers potent residual protection of up to 3 months in a single application.

Quick & Easy Application – Ready-to-use, water-based formulation. Spray the infested area using the spray bottle provided at a rate of 25 – 50 ml per metre square. Can also be applied as a space spray at a rate of 1 – 4 ml per cubic metre. Read the label before application.
description: Hiding in the dark corners of your closet, basement or attic, tiny winged monsters feed on fabric! If you’ve noticed lots of tiny holes throughout your wardrobe, Clothes Moths could be the culprit. Clothes moths adore warm, centrally-heated homes and their larvae consume organic fibres of any kind. Prevent and stop irreparable damage to your clothes, upholstery and carpets with NOPE! CP Moth Killer Spray. NOPE!’s non-staining cypermethrin-based formula mimics the naturally occurring insecticidal properties of part of the Chrysanthemum flower to attract clothes moths and extinguish the infestation.NOPE! CP Moth Killer Spray can be applied directly to soft furnishings and the interior surfaces of wardrobes and drawers. Defend your wardrobe and protect valuable woollen carpets and plush toys from destruction. NOPE! CP Moth Killer Spray can also be used for craft wool, feather and felt. Always remove bedding and clothes in immediate contact with people and pets. Spray the infested area for quick elimination.
